role: M1 Archive AI presenter (holographic narrator, SystemPresenter.tsx)
why: The prior system-presenter-rigged.glb was a modern figure in an open jacket with a bare chest, visible in the head-and-shoulders REACTION/PRESENTER_MEDIUM framings the presenter is mostly seen in. That is a Grade-8 Texas classroom shipping blocker. This is a drop-in replacement: a composed, fully-covered institutional field-service figure, same glbKey, same clip names, same rig contract, so no consumer or content edit is required.

pipeline.reference: a neutral-light render of the CURRENT presenter (continuity: she is a persistent character who must not flicker between media)
pipeline.prompt: same woman, same face and long blonde hair, redressed in a high-necked slate-grey institutional field-service jacket zipped to the throat, fully covered chest and neckline, matching trousers, subtle circular archive insignia, calm and professional, neutral flat-lit studio background, full body
pipeline.qa: visual/historical QA PASS: not period/colonial dress; institutional not fashion/costume/glamour; fully covered high neckline; age-appropriate; legible and dignified in close-up; recognisably the same handler

pipeline.params: pose_mode t-pose, symmetry on, should_texture, enable_pbr false, target_polycount 50000

pipeline.tool: Meshy rigging API (the same deterministic 24-joint Meshy skeleton every existing cast rig uses)
pipeline.produces: Hips/Spine/Spine01/Spine02/neck/Head + limbs, 24 joints; single skinned mesh; Head and neck are the gaze joints SystemPresenter rotates

pipeline.effect: drops the Meshy placeholder clip and clamps oversize textures; target 60000 > mesh so NO decimation (an earlier 44k pass tore the feet for an 11% triangle saving, so decimation was dropped)

scripts: assets/pipeline/apply_presenter_appearance_fix.py (weld coincident seam verts 35881 -> 24809, shade smooth, swap warm albedo)
pipeline.effect: removes the Meshy split-vertex facet shards on the face

pipeline.result: jawOpen morph, moved 982 verts, max drop 0.0206 m, nothing above the upper lip; drives moduleLipSync.JAW_OPEN_MORPH

pipeline.script: assets/pipeline/reground_rig.py (NEW: a single vertical translate so the clip-baked rest pose puts the feet on z=0)
assets/pipeline/fix_rig_emissive.py (clears the Meshy whole-body-albedo-as-emissive; the check-world-textures publish guard requires this, as it did for the shipped cast)

gates.verify_presenter_face.py: PASS (jawOpen morph, idle/talk/talk2 clips, 24 joints, 1 material/texture, feet at 0, height in band)
gates.check-world-scale.mjs: PASS (effective height 1.700m, in the 1.2-2.3m human band; not manifest-declared)
gates.assets:verify:placement|collision|afford: PASS (unaffected: a character is not route/collision/affordance geometry)
gates.runtime hologram capture: presenterQa under the real hologram material; window.__presenterJaw driven 0 -> 0.215 (lip-sync live on the new mesh); Head/neck gaze visible across shots

notes: Drop-in: glbKey, talkClip and idleClip in content/m1/module.json are unchanged, so no module or content edit is needed.

Cosmetic, not blocking: a faint hair-to-face seam (the Meshy long-hair shell overlapping the jaw) survives the weld; it is largely absorbed by the runtime hologram tint/rim and the prior asset carried the same class of seam.
Texture is 2048 (hero close-up) vs the cast's mix; file size 3.83 MB is in line (the cast ships 4-5 MB albedos).
